t: The DEWALT TSTAK VI deep storage system provides robust tool organisation for managing multiple hand tools and power tools on site. Built from durable polypropylene with water-resistant properties, this toolbox features one large compartment plus a removable tray for smaller items, keeping everything organised and protected. Hinged lid with durable metal clamps ensures secure closure whilst the integrated carrying handle allows easy portability between job sites. Offers 30kg load capacity, and full compatibility with the TSTAK stacking system for flexible storage solutions.
